items.name: Mabli's Salt-Pouch
items.lore: Salt for circles, salt for ghosts, salt for supper. Mabli never goes anywhere without it.

items.name: Miner's Lamp-Ring
items.lore: A ring of blackened iron that a ghost wore for two hundred years. It still smells of lamp-oil.

items.name: Cockatrice-Shell Bracer
items.lore: Speckled shell, set in bronze. Magus Idris was not pleased to see it in your hands.

items.name: Foreman's Belt
items.lore: Thick leather, and a ring of keys to tunnels long fallen in.

items.name: Hill-Chief's Torque
items.lore: Twisted bronze, scratched with the marks of every chief before Alrek.

items.name: Crimson-Thread Cloak
items.lore: Unpicked from an initiate's robe and woven back the other way. The red has dulled to brown.

items.name: Hrodda's Bone Bracer
items.lore: Carved with a hill-tribe pattern that means 'guest'.

items.name: Bounty-Hunter's Belt
items.lore: Captain Mardoc's own. He said you'd earned it. He didn't look at you when he said it.

items.name: Warg-Pelt Bracer
items.lore: Grey and coarse. Warm in the wind off the crags.

items.name: Garrison Picket Ring
items.lore: Every picket on the west road wears one.

items.name: Cockatrice-Quill Charm
items.lore: A stiff red quill. Don't look at it too long.

items.name: Mine-Hill Belt
items.lore: Tomas's own. He says he's done with the hills.

items.name: Three-Beak Torc
items.lore: Three beaks, gilded, on a bronze torc.

items.name: Stone-Gaze Bracer
items.lore: Its owner never once turned to stone.

items.name: Brood-Breaker's Cloak
items.lore: Red feathers stitched in a pattern only the miners understand.

items.name: Smuggler's Hidden-Pocket Belt
items.lore: Seven hidden pockets. You've found five.

items.name: Red-Road Ring
items.lore: A plain iron ring, worn by the garrison on the Red Road.

items.name: Tracker's Leaf-Cloak
items.lore: Green and brown, sewn with real leaves that never wither.

items.name: Snare-Wire Ring
items.lore: Twisted from a tracker's snare.

items.name: Forest Chief's Antler Torc
items.lore: Antler and bronze. He wore it like a crown.

items.name: Ledger-Lock Charm
items.lore: The lock off the chief's ledger. The key's gone.

items.name: Red Road Breaker's Mantle
items.lore: Garrison grey. Mardoc's gift.

items.name: Prophecy-Stone Ring
items.lore: A pebble scratched with ogham. Taliesin read it aloud once and wouldn't again.

items.name: Bard's Satchel-Strap
items.lore: Taliesin's spare. It's carried a hundred songs.

items.name: Unknotted Cord
items.lore: A red cord with every knot burned out of it.

items.name: South Woods Bracer
items.lore: Mossy leather. Smells of the south woods.

items.name: Warm Green Cloak
items.lore: Green wool, lined. The Cauld Lad wore it for a moment and was warm.

items.name: Brownie's Hob-Nail Ring
items.lore: A hob-nail bent into a ring.

items.name: Lullaby Charm
items.lore: Taliesin's lullaby, written very small on a scrap of vellum.

items.name: Necromancer's Bone-Clasp
items.lore: A finger-bone clasp. It twitches.

items.name: Cairn-Stone Bracer
items.lore: Set with a stone from the necromancers' cairn.

items.name: Letter-Seal Ring
items.lore: Morgana's seal, struck through with a knife.

items.name: Howling Maiden's Veil
items.lore: Grey gauze. It sings faintly in the wind.

items.name: Crag-Walker's Torc
items.lore: Silver, cold as the crags.

items.name: Cut Red Cord
items.lore: A tribesman's cord, cut through. He thanked you for it.

items.name: Hill-Shaman's Rattle-Charm
items.lore: Seeds in a gourd. It rattles a warning.

items.name: Alrek's Chief-Ring
items.lore: Gold, heavy, very old. The chiefs of the hills have worn it for twenty generations.

items.name: Hill-Daughter's Mantle
items.lore: Woven by Hrodda herself, red cord unpicked from the hem.

items.name: Freed Chief's Torc
items.lore: Alrek gave it you, or Hrodda did. Either way it's yours.

items.name: Emrys Gate-Stone Ring
items.lore: A chip of the fort's gate, set in iron.

items.name: Hill-Fort Bracer
items.lore: Garrison-made, for the assault on the fort.

items.name: Dragon-Priest's Stole
items.lore: Red silk embroidered with a dragon, unpicked at the eyes.

items.name: Red Dragon Scale
items.lore: A scale from the red dragon of Vortigern's tower. Warm, always.

items.name: White Dragon Scale
items.lore: A scale from the white dragon - Golestandt's. It's cold enough to burn.

items.name: Taliesin's Harp-String Ring
items.lore: A harp-string wound into a ring. It hums when danger's near.

items.name: Mantle of Emrys's Fort
items.lore: Grey and red, with the dragons. Given to those who closed the pit.
